description: Append selected backlog tasks to the currently active cycle without creating a new cycle. The prepare call validates the project-scoped task set and returns a handoff-generation prompt; the apply call atomically writes every BUILD HANDOFF, task membership, and the cycle roster. Duplicate, cross-project, already-assigned, or partial task sets fail without mutation. Does not call the Anthropic API.

cycle_number.description: The active cycle number returned by prepare (apply mode).

llm_response_file.description: Local file containing the complete handoff output (apply mode on local stdio only).

mode.description: Prepare a handoff prompt or apply the generated handoffs.

task_ids.description: Backlog task IDs to append. Required in prepare mode.

name: cycle_append
